title: What's New: Enhanced Demo Data (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Sales and Purchasing Demo Data Enhancements
Demo Tools and Related Analytics Sessions

features.name: Fixed Assets Transaction Demo Data
features.description: Added transaction data for acquisitions and depreciations in fixed assets. This enables demos of fixed asset reports, analysis mode on fixed asset ledgers, and FA registers.

features.name: Sales Demo Data Enhancements
features.description: Added more document demo data with variation spread across sales people, added discounts, and 11 additional open sales orders plus 9 more back orders to improve Power BI app demonstrations.

features.name: Purchasing Demo Data Enhancements
features.description: Added purchasing department dimension and purchase return order demo data, along with variation in documents to improve Power BI app demonstrations.

features.name: Finance General Ledger Improvement
features.description: Finance general ledger benefits from demo data enhancements in sales and purchasing as documents post through, improving the overall demo experience in finance.

features.name: Subscription Billing Demo Data
features.description: Added master data and transactions for subscription billing including more customer contracts, vendor contracts, and billing lines. Lights up analysis mode in the client and Power BI app.

features.name: Analysis Mode on Lists
features.description: Demonstrates using lists in analysis mode within Business Central as an alternative to Power BI apps for viewing reports and data visualization.

features.name: Demo Data Control Tool
features.description: A tool under analytics that can be installed to access enhanced demo data across fixed assets, sales, purchasing, and subscription billing. Can be extended to other scenarios.
caveats: can be extended to other scenarios
